SECRET_HINTS = ("PASSWORD", "PASSWD", "SECRET", "TOKEN", "_KEY", "PRIVATE")


def map_service(name, spec):
    """把一个 compose service 映射成 K8s 对象列表。"""
    objs = []
    ports = spec.get("ports") or []
    volumes = spec.get("volumes") or []
    env = spec.get("environment") or {}
    has_state = any(":" in str(v) and not str(v).startswith("./") for v in volumes)
    replicas = spec.get("deploy", {}).get("replicas", 1)
    if has_state:
        objs.append("StatefulSet/%s (replicas=%d)" % (name, replicas))
    else:
        objs.append("Deployment/%s (replicas=%d)" % (name, replicas))
    if ports:
        published = [p for p in ports if str(p).count(":") >= 1]
        stype = "NodePort" if published else "ClusterIP"
        objs.append("Service/%s type=%s ports=%s" % (name, stype, ports))
    else:
        objs.append("Service/%s type=ClusterIP headless（仅集群内 DNS）" % name)
    if spec.get("healthcheck"):
        hc = spec["healthcheck"]
        objs.append("probe: readinessProbe+livenessProbe interval=%ss retries=%s"
                    % (hc.get("interval", "30s").rstrip("s"), hc.get("retries", 3)))
    if env:
        plain = [k for k in env if not any(h in k.upper() for h in SECRET_HINTS)]
        secret = [k for k in env if any(h in k.upper() for h in SECRET_HINTS)]
        if plain:
            objs.append("ConfigMap/%s-env keys=%d" % (name, len(plain)))
        if secret:
            objs.append("Secret/%s-secret keys=%d" % (name, len(secret)))
    limits = spec.get("deploy", {}).get("resources", {}).get("limits", {})
    if limits:
        objs.append("resources.limits %s" % limits)
    return objs


def map_volume(vname, vdef):
    if isinstance(vdef, dict) and vdef.get("driver") == "local" and vdef.get("driver_opts"):
        return "PersistentVolume/%s (hostPath=%s)" % (vname, vdef["driver_opts"].get("device", "?"))
    return "PersistentVolumeClaim/%s" % vname

        "web": {

            "deploy": {"replicas": 3, "resources": {"limits": {"memory": "512Mi", "cpus": "0.5"}}},

PAIRS = [
    ("service（无状态）", "Deployment + Service"),
    ("service（有状态+命名卷）", "StatefulSet + Service(headless) + PVC"),
    ("depends_on", "initContainer 等待 / readiness 门控（K8s 无原生顺序保证）"),
    ("healthcheck", "livenessProbe + readinessProbe + startupProbe"),
    ("restart: always", "Deployment 的 restartPolicy: Always（由控制器重建 Pod）"),
    ("named volume", "PersistentVolumeClaim"),
    ("bind mount", "hostPath（不推荐）或 ConfigMap 挂载"),
    ("environment（非敏感）", "ConfigMap"),
    ("environment（敏感）", "Secret"),
    ("ports 发布", "Service(NodePort/LoadBalancer) 或 Ingress"),
    ("mem_limit / cpus", "resources.limits / resources.requests"),
]

    print("  %-28s -> %s" % (a, b))
print()

print("=== 2. 逐服务生成的对象清单 ===")
all_objs = []
for name, spec in COMPOSE["services"].items():
    objs = map_service(name, spec)
    print("  service %s:" % name)
    for o in objs:
        print("      %s" % o)
    all_objs.extend(objs)
print()

print("=== 3. 卷映射 ===")
for vname, vdef in COMPOSE["volumes"].items():
    m = map_volume(vname, vdef)
    print("  volume %-10s -> %s" % (vname, m))
    all_objs.append(m)
print()

kinds = [o.split("/")[0].split(" ")[0] for o in all_objs]

print("  生成对象总数 = %d" % len(all_objs))

print()
